rules.title: ESLint flat config
rules.text: Configure ESLint with the flat config and keep rules in version control.

rules.title: Prettier owns formatting
rules.text: Let Prettier own formatting and keep ESLint to code-quality rules.

rules.title: Do not disable rules inline
rules.text: Do not add eslint-disable comments; fix the code or change the rule in config with a reason.

rules.title: Lint in CI
rules.text: Run lint with zero warnings allowed in CI.
